create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 high-height dual-frequency projective reduction
create.statement_tex: Fix X>=2, a nonempty literal middle or lower residual hard-M1 shell L>=2, sigma in {+1,-1}, fixed B>0, Q=H_B=floor((log(2X))^B), and a nonempty dyadic Y<h<=2Y with Y>Q. On the exact accepted Round-188 complement U=mq>4Q, q>Q, m|a|_q>Q, Qm<Y, the inherited carrier has U,m,q odd and q|U|u. Put j_q(a,v)=|a inverse(v mod q)|_q and T_Q=min((q-1)/2,floor(Qmq/Y)). The complete sector 1<=j_q(a,v)<=T_Q has total absolute size O_(B,epsilon)(L^2X^epsilon). For fixed a it uses O(uT_Q/q)<=O(Qum/Y) literal v values; O(Y) heights and O(kappa) affine sites, the exact c_(mq)(ma)=m^(-1)c_q(a) lift weight, coefficient mass O(log(2q)), and sum_(mq|u)1=tau_3(u) cancel Y and m before outer positivity. The exact complementary aggregate j_q(a,v)>T_Q remains under one outer real part over both orientations and every literal selector, deletion, endpoint, phase, affine site, terminal block, and zero extension. Its target is open. On J<=j_q(a,v)<2J a sufficient fixed-a variation input is sum_(omega,v) V(W_v) << Qm kappa u J q^(-1) X^epsilon, while the available bound is only Y kappa u J q^(-1) X^epsilon, with deficit Y/(Qm) and primitive deficit Y/Q. Odd-conductor centering has a prime slope -2 prefix of size (p-1)/2, so it supplies no uniform polylogarithmic prefix theorem; this is not literal lower mass. This node proves only the strict projective sector and exact reduction, not the fast complement, complete high-height relation, complete t=1 residual, small-t owner, any parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent.
create.next_action: Prove the exact one-sided fast complement j_q(a,v)>min((q-1)/2,floor(H_Bmq/Y)) uniformly for every dyadic Y>H_B, retaining U=mq>4H_B, q>H_B, m|a|_q>H_B, H_Bm<Y, both orientations, all h,v,t,a, and every literal selector, deletion, endpoint, phase, affine site, and zero extension under one outer real part. Establish the fixed-a dyadic actual-coefficient variation bound sum_(omega,v) V(W_v) << H_B m kappa u J/q times X^epsilon, or a genuinely joint signed substitute with the same final ledger. Assumed bounded variation, uniform centered-kernel prefixes, positive completion energy, and selector-blind sieve opening are not substitutes.

reject.reason: U/Y is the power-neutral baseline, but every predeclared fixed polylogarithmic enlargement is target-safe with its explicit polylogarithmic cost.
The exact reduced scale is mq/Y=U/Y; omitting m loses the actual projective multiplicity supplied by the lift.
Because q divides u and (u,v)=1, v is a unit modulo q and v maps to a inverse(v) bijectively on unit classes.
Each class occurs O(u/q+1)=O(u/q) times because q divides u, so no stray additive term remains.
The exact identity c_(mq)(ma)=m^(-1)c_q(a) cancels the factor m before divisor summation.
Only j_q(a,v)<=T_Q is paid; the exact fast complement j_q(a,v)>T_Q remains open.
For odd q the cap (q-1)/2 contains every unit least-residue slope, so the fast complement is empty on a saturated lift.
The q/J geometric bound applies to a constant coefficient; the actual zero-extended endpoint sequence requires Abel variation or joint discrepancy control.
Pointwise O(kappa X^epsilon) only gives variation O(Y kappa X^epsilon), larger than the sufficient scale by Y/(Qm).
Coprimality, squarefree, selector, profile, anchor, endpoint, Fejer, phase, affine birth/death, and zero-extension fields can all jump with height.
For odd prime p the centered slope -2 prefix is exactly -(p-1)/2.
The survivor belongs to the full centered kernel, while the literal fast packet retains deletions, masks, endpoints, orientations, and the projective split.
Positive completion, Poisson, large-sieve, and alias norms return residue-bucket capacity and do not prove actual-coefficient variation.
The exact fast high-height complement remains open before the accepted t=1 connectors can close.
Every complete M1 and M2 route, endpoint uniformity, M9, both bridges, and the quarter theorem remain incomplete.
